reviews.text: We hired Kristina after we got our 3rd puppy, 3 years after our beloved dog died. We thought we were experienced and would go through the typical puppy stage. Well, our new little puppy turned out to be the most difficult we've ever had... She is very smart and dominant! When crossed, she would not hesitate to sink her teeth in! That is when we realized we needed professional help. Thank goodness we found Kristina! She absolutely saved us. She showed us how to deal with the biting issues along with the basic training/manners that our puppy needed (it had been a while since we last had a puppy). We now know how to deal with the issues we were having. If it wasn't for Kristina's help, not sure what would have happened. I would highly recommend Kristina as a trainer. She guided us through some pretty difficult times with our young dog. Thank goodness everything worked out, we have a really sweet, but feisty dog who is well behaved!
Kristina is an amazing trainer and overall an incredible person. She is kind and honest and truly understands dogs and their behaviours. Kristina will support you through anything you throw her way.

Excellent and kind care with great expertise on dog training.

With Kristina’s instructor and my consistent training between sessions, I found great improvement with my dogs behaviour and their overall happiness.

Highly recommend.

Hi Af Modami, I have no record of ever having you as a client. The photo of the cupboard hinge, and the mouldy walls are not photos of my business. It appears you were trying to rate an apartment in my building perhaps? These photos also has nothing to do with what we do here at Hairy Tales. We train  dogs. We don't do painting or construction. I think you might have rated the wrong business. Please consider taking down your review as negative reviews like this can negatively affect our business. Many thanks.

My Mexican rescue dog is doing SO much better after we got some training from Kristina at Happy Tails. She is more confident and less reactive, and we feel 100% better equipped to handle her behaviors. Kristina is such a wealth of knowledge and I highly recommend her to help with any rescue dogs (or any dogs, for that matter). Thank you so much!
Great insight into dogs and their training needs! We are grateful for the training!

Wonderful experience! We really debated whether to get a doodle puppy but with Kristina’s help and training strategies we learned how to handle situations. Really “We” were being trained to better communicate with our pup! Kristina helped us overcome some of our fears and was particularly great in suggesting products and services. We are very grateful for your guidance. Taurus will see you again.

My dog, Rollo, a 16 month old border collie, was traumatized by a vet visit and consequently did not want anyone handling or touching him and he unfortunately bit our dog walker for trying to attach his leash. He is also reactive with certain dogs. He has come a long way after three sessions with Kristina and had a very successful vet visit recently where he received three shots. (His previous visits have been quite disastrous as he has been quite aggressive towards the vets landing a couple of bites).

Kristina has been instrumental in helping me to get Rollo to trust me more and be less fearful. It’s good to know that there are solutions and thankfully trainers like Kristina who with her incredible expertise and the strategies that she provides you with, can allow your dog to have its best life. I had to wait quite a while to get my first appointment with Kristina as she is in high demand but she is well worth the wait
I enjoyed our training session with Kristina. Lots of information to take back and it was exactly what I was looking for.

I had my first web session with Kristina yesterday, and I can assure you, she is worth the wait! We are working together on improving my relationship with my dog, which Kristina explained was the underlying reason why my dog seems like he has "a short fuse" around other dogs.
Kristina is articulate, to the point yet also very kind and understanding. It felt like chatting with an old friend. There was zero judgement when I confessed all of my mistakes to her, for which I am very grateful! (lol). I feel confident that my dog and I are going to get to a much better place with her guidance.
Astonishing sessions with Kristina for addressing  the roots for the behavior of our two leash reactive /resource guarding dogs.

Kristina has a magical rapport with dogs.  From the moment our puppy Nico met Kristina, it was as though she was a beloved long lost friend – an overflow of joy!

My husband and I had signed up for the five-session package for puppies.  Was it expensive?  Yes.  Was it worth the price?  For us, absolutely!  This was our first pet as a family and we viewed the training as an investment in raising a loving, well-mannered dog as part of our family.  Our first session at Hairy Tales was before Nico’s arrival at nine weeks.  We learned useful skills on how to prepare for the first couple of weeks.  A critical learning was how long to play with Nico before ensuring he was back in his crate for a long rest.  Another important learning was what to do when Nico fussed after being left alone.  We also found out what products to get before Nico came home; this saved us a lot of time trying to figure out what would work.  We even got a listing of recommended vets.  And thankfully, we got essential tips on how to potty train.  This session truly set us up for success.

Each of the remaining sessions was customized to the challenges we were facing and the goals we wanted to achieve.  For example, at the third session, we asked for help with Nico’s fear of larger cars and trucks (he used to shake with fear and try to dash back home).  Kristina didn’t simply tell us what to do, she took us all out on the street and showed us what to do.  And now, when a large truck goes by, Nico may pause to look out of interest or will ignore it completely.  By the fourth session, Nico was so confident that we actually needed to learn how to teach him boundaries (such as not jumping on people who would like to pet him).  Another key example was training Nico to “leave it”.  Nico, true to his Boston Terrier heritage, resisted but Kristina persisted; watching Kristina in action was like attending a Master Class.

We couldn’t be happier with the results.  Nico came to us from amazing breeders who gave him an excellent start (thank you, Donna and Jack at Dalhousie Kennels).  Kristina shared her expertise and guidance with us to help Nico become the confident, joyful puppy he is today. Hairy Tales has truly been an invaluable part of Nico’s early life…and likely will be at various stages to come…teenage phase next – yikes!
Kristina answered all my questions before I even had a chance to ask. She is thorough and approachable. Highly recommend!
Kristina was fantastic to work with. She’s knowledgeable, patient, and really cares for the dogs and families she works with.

Kristina is extremely knowledgeable and experienced in training dogs with all kinds of issues. We have already made great headway with our rambunctious three month old golden retriever puppy, after only two classes. She follows up with notes and assignments in between sessions which is very helpful. She has also provided many helpful tips and invaluable advice. We highly recommend her.

My husband and I, and our 15 month old Miniature Schnazuer Pyper are working with Kristina towards Pyper's certification (and us as owners!) as a visiting therapy dog.  We could not be happier with Kristina's guidance and expertise as together we take this path and work towards this important goal.

Kristina has been a huge help with both our dogs, including our rescue who has a lot of anxiety and trust issues. We’ve only had a few sessions with her and by implementing her advice have already seen some remarkable changes. She really understands the psychology of dogs. Always responsive and professional, as well. Can’t recommend her enough.
Kristina is incredible insightful as well as so thorough when going through everything you want to accomplish/how we are going to get their with your dog's goals!

We have a 1 year old rescue dog who was very reactive to people in our home and especially to other dogs on the street. After just two sessions with Kristina, and applying the strategies and tools that she has given us, we have already noticed significant improvements in our dog's behaviour. She is much less anxious, which of course has lessened our anxiety too. We still have much work ahead but Kristina has got us off to a great start and set us on a good pathway. She's an excellent trainer: professional, knowledgeable, compassionate and effective. She understands dogs and people.

Kristina was amazing in helping us with our dogs' sudden fights for attention. Our lives are now back to normal and we can happily cuddle with both of our girls once again. Consistency is key. Thank you!!

Kristina has been an amazing partner in my dog’s training. She’s provided realistic and manageable guidance and tools to help my dog get along with another dog.  She’s also helped correct other frustrating behaviours along the way, both my dog and I are happier.
We loved our first session with Kristina! Calm, extremely knowledgable and practical - we are looking forward to working with her to resolve our dogs nervous reactivity!
I had a wonderful first session with Kristina. She understands a dog's body language and helped me with some tools I could start using immediately. Highly recommend her.
Wonderful 1st session with Kristina! Very indepth with a calm laid back manner. We now have a gameplan & assessment of our pup moving forward. Five stars!
Very informative first session. We learned new things already and we're looking forward to putting the tools into practice.

Kristina knows her profession inside out. She's has that special talent for understanding dog behaviours and a matter-of-fact way of presenting clear steps for correcting undesirable behaviour. Exactly what I needed for my dog's loud insistent demanding barking. THANK YOU!

Kristina is a dog whisperer and a godsend. We're first time dog owners and we didn't realize how much we didn't realize. Kristina was able to hear our concerns and adjust our behaviours and training, so that our puppy can behave in cooperation with our life.

We'd tried two other dog training places with less effective, efficient results. Kristina actually listens and then provides effective solutions. Can't recommend her highly enough.

We had our introductory meet and greet and really enjoyed the experience. Kristina is friendly, knowledgeable, and made me feel comfortable right away. I’ve already started to implement some of the tips she recommended. I am looking forward to future training sessions!
I’m really grateful to have met Kristina for my 10-year-old dog, and for all the advice and strategies she has shared with us to help me understand him better.

We met Kristina for the first time today for help with training our rescue dog Rhodi. We found Kristina incredibly knowledgeable about dog behaviour and able to articulate how to achieve results with Rhodi, all with a pleasant manner. We look forward to working with Kristina as she helps us build a constructive relationship with Rhodi.

We recently adopted our rescue 6 year old West Highland Terrier and needed some guidance on her challenges with small children. Kristina met with me for a 90 minute session and gave me a list of training methods that I have been implementing. Her knowledge and understanding of dogs is extraordinary and I look forward to the next session with her.  I can, with confidence, highly recommend Kristina - a very inspirational person.

We had an initial training session with Kristina and our minds were blown learning about dog psychology and how it related to us and our dog's behavior. We have been implementing Kristina's homework and already seeing improvement. We are excited about what we'll learn in future sessions and how we can live harmoniously together with our new rescue pup. Highly recommend!!

We recently had our first 90-minute session with Kristina for our new puppy, and we couldn’t be more grateful. As second-time dog owners but first-time puppy parents, we were feeling pretty anxious—our pup is 6 months old and hadn’t had any formal training yet, so we felt like we were playing catch-up.

Kristina immediately put us at ease. She provided practical, easy-to-implement tools and tips that we started using right away—and we’ve already seen noticeable improvements in our puppy’s behavior! Her approach is clear, direct, and tailored to our needs, which made a huge difference in our confidence.

Both of our dogs have now been trained by Kristina, and we wouldn’t trust anyone else. We’re feeling much more optimistic and excited for our next session. Highly recommend her to anyone looking for a knowledgeable and experienced trainer!

Kristina has been so helpful with tips and practice to get Kloe more comfortable and less reactive/afraid for her 'people' at the swimming pool. She has taught us useful techniques and made the experience a combination of instructive and really fun and playful. We hope the progress we've seen so far continues. We feel much more confident working with Kristina on this and look forward to calmer summer days poolside in future.
We just had our first session, and it was great! Kristina really took her time getting to know our dogs behaviours and tendencies. We definitely learned a lot!

Kristina is a wealth of very valuable information! We spent 90 minutes with her and came away with a laundry list of tools and tips to help our reactive dog. She also explained the psychology of dogs who react and this alone was worth every cent.  We now feel equipped and empowered to being our training.  Highly recommend!

I adopted a rescue dog who has some crazy guarding behaviours, particularly of people and his space. Within one session of discussing why dogs do that, we were able to eliminate almost all incidents of him going after my other dog or other people. We’ve done three sessions now and we’ve been able to thoroughly improve his behaviour, improve leash manners, and learn more about him. Kristina is incredible. If you have a dog with behavioural issues or you have dogs adjusting to living together, she should be your #1 choice.

We had our first session with Kristina and it was very eye opening, she is very professional and knowledgeable. We feel confident that our rescue dog will be able to overcome his anxiety and we already have homework to do, so now we feel that we know how we can start to communicate better with our sweet little guy.

Had our first consult with Kristina and she is amazing! Very knowledgeable in what she does and is providing us with the right steps to help our dog. Looking forward to the remainder of our sessions with her. Already feel like we have a better understanding of our dog and his behaviors from Kristina’s help

As I keep learning and being consistent I know I will see the results I am striving for, for a healthier relationship with my dog and his reactive and protective behavior.
I have 40 angry chihuahuas needed ingredients training?!?!.!     I here your the specialist

Today was our first day of training for Lucy the boxers e collar it was great ! She loves Kristina as we do ! Kristina trained us all when Lucy was a puppy 2 yrs ago and today Lucy came in with a waggy boxer wiggle  !

My mind is still blown, 2 days past my first training session with Kristina. Talking through the psychology of my dogs' behaviours, the power dynamic, the guarding, and so much more was WAY more than I expected from this 90-minute session. I have a lot of work ahead but knowing I'll return to work with Kristina brings me so much confidence. I have some very specific work to do in the coming weeks but the fact that I know WHY and HOW thanks to our time is priceless. Highly recommend!
Really enjoyed our first class with Kristina. I feel more confident with my dog already and I'm excited for us to reach the next level together.

We began working with Kristina in October after we rescued a 5 year old shih tzu (puppy mill rescue). Our dog was terrified of everything-the most debilitating being cars.  Kristina used a firm but gentle approach with her, and after several sessions, she is much less scared of cars. She now loves to go for walks and I have Kristina to thank for that. We recently began working on desensitizing her to noises in the house (I.e. aluminum foil, buttons on the oven/microwave) and she's doing very well. I highly recommend Kristina-she is a superstar.
Love training with Kristina. Very informative and educational. We still have a long way to go, but it's been very positive so far.

I was really surprised at how fast it worked. I was told by other trainers that my dog was difficult to train and it might take months to see actual changes. But my dog's behaviors changed significantly right after the first session. It gave us confidence to keep moving forward.

We have really benefited from Kristina’s services. As new dog owners, we have needed guidance and structured training and Kristina has guided us along the way.

Today’s session with our children was especially helpful to see a typical day in our house and how to train our dog accordingly.

We have completed our 5 sessions of training with Kristina for our puppy. Kristina is a wonderful trainer and we have seen so much progress with our pup in a very short time. She is happy to concentrate on areas important to your individual family and she is also amazing at explaining the long term affects of certain behaviours of which might not have occurred to me.
We are going to continue our training with Kristina for e-collar training for our dog.
She is also a pleasure to work with and is positive and encouraging.
Amazing trainer! Kristina really knows her stuff. Hire with confidence.

We had our first session today to see if we could get our dog to walk upstairs after a scare she had at home where we believe she fell. It took all of a few minutes a harness and trainer Kristina, to have her going up steep stairs like a champ!  Will continue work at home.  Best day ever for all of us.  Kristina offered fantastic tips and help on behaviours of our dog guarding behaviours we were not aware of. Looking forward to follow up session and a huge thank you!  Additional work using the wealth of information and guidance from trainer on our pups reactiveness on walks and close space to smaller dogs.
